title: EvoBench: An Evolving, Diagnostic Benchmark Framework for Environmental Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.35464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning models are now widely used to predict environmental variable dynamics in domains like hydrology, climate science, agriculture, and ecology. These models are usually compared on fixed benchmark datasets using a single average accuracy score. As models improve, their scores become very close when averaged over large regions and long time periods, so the benchmark can no longer tell them apart, and a single number hides \emph{where} and \emph{when} a model fails. Three failures are common across environmental domains: models get worse as the climate shifts (non-stationarity), models fail at unmonitored sites (spatial extrapolation), and models miss rare but important regimes such as floods and droughts.   We present \textbf{EvoBench}, a benchmark framework that shows where a model fails, tracks failures over time, and evolves to focus on model capability gaps. We apply EvoBench to daily streamflow prediction as a case study

translated_title: EvoBench：一个不断演化的环境建模诊断式基准框架
translated_abstract: 机器学习模型如今被广泛应用于水文学、气候科学、农业和生态学等领域，用于预测环境变量的动态变化。这些模型通常在固定的基准数据集上以单一的平均精度分数进行比较。随着模型不断改进，在大范围区域和长时间周期上取平均后，它们的分数变得非常接近，导致基准测试无法再区分不同模型，且单一数字掩盖了模型“在何处”和“何时”失败。环境领域中存在三种常见的失效模式：随着气候变迁模型性能下降（非平稳性）、模型在未监测站点上表现不佳（空间外推），以及模型遗漏洪水和干旱等罕见但重要的状态。我们提出了EvoBench，这是一个能够揭示模型在何处失败、随时间追踪失效情况、并不断演化以聚焦模型能力缺口的基准框架。我们以每日径流预测为案例研究应用了EvoBench。
tldr: EvoBench是一个诊断式演化基准框架，能够精确定位环境建模机器学习模型在空间和时间上的失效点（如非平稳性、空间外推和极端事件），并随模型能力提升而不断演化以持续揭示剩余的能力缺口。
en_tdlr: EvoBench is an evolving, diagnostic benchmark framework that reveals where and when machine learning models fail in environmental modeling—such as under non-stationarity, spatial extrapolation, and extreme events—and evolves over time to target remaining capability gaps.
